Test-set script mix is verified only visually on 13/13 viewed crops (Bengali handwriting); a Tesseract-based H1 read of 70 samples gave 35.7% Devanagari, unresolved. No full 5,344 script-ID audit exists.

Official scoring metric, submission format and deadline are UNKNOWN; the 'CER+bootstrap CI+WER+S/D/I+s/page' rubric came from a student B.Tech repo, and '>95% WLA, <1 s/page' is the 2023 Bhashini challenge, not AksharDrishti. No official dataset/split/sample is published.

Only labelled handwriting on disk is Datasets/akshardrishti_official/Bodo/gu = IIIT-INDIC-HW-WORDS Gujarati (4,645 images present vs 82,563 train / 16,490 H2 slice); visually Bodo/gu/test/test/1.jpg is Gujarati handwriting with a valid label. No Bengali handwriting labelled set is local.
H2 Gujarati slice has no writer_id/page_id, so writer-disjointness cannot be proven from the manifest; images on disk are mispathed (test/test/ resolution needed).

IIIT-INDIC-HW-WORDS licence = CC BY 4.0 (AIKosh); Bengali train 82,554 / val 12,947 (IHTR-2022 page also lists test 18,574, summary says 17,575); IHTR-2022 page is 'All Rights Reserved' and IHTR-2023/IHDR-2025 are academic-use, so those are eval-only.

ICDAR 2023 IHTR: train = IIIT-INDIC-HW-WORDS; NEW val 1,000 + test 5,000 words/lang from 100 writers. PERO used IIIT val/test as extra training, so its numbers are not clean. Bengali WRR 96.10 (Upstage) is a vendor-style top score, not a gate transfer.

Independent Bengali handwriting eval candidates: BN-HTRd (108,181 words, 150 writers, 786 pages; licence unchecked) and ICDAR'23 test (100 new writers, obtainability unknown). Mandela rule: perceptual-hash the 5,344 test images against all IIIT-HW bn splits and ICDAR'23 sets before any training.
